scope: Fixed assistant user-task acceptance plus real chat/job/proposal integration

integration_results.access_scope: owner-scoped sessions and proposals; inaccessible objects return 403/404
integration_results.revision_conflict: stale proposal apply returns 412 and does not change the current revision
integration_results.cancel: queued chat job reaches cancelled without a completed assistant claim
integration_results.human_gate: tool call creates a pending proposal; a separate current-revision apply is required

boundaries: The set is deterministic and does not claim universal absence of model errors
